sentence: This project uses ultrafast lasers to watch how the atoms in a molecule move when light triggers a chemical reaction.
This project studies how male and female bagworm moths come to look so different when they share almost the same genes.
This project studies the chemistry of how jet fuel ignites again in an aircraft engine after the flame goes out at high altitude.
This project builds modules that measure precisely when and where particles pass, for use in a detector at a particle collider.
This project tracks how people who return to doctoral study in computing after working contribute to research in areas such as artificial intelligence.
This project develops methods for choosing between statistical models, and tests how well they work when the assumptions behind the models are wrong.
This project uses a single-celled ciliate that lives with algae to find the genes that make their partnership work.
This project studies dark matter by measuring light from quasars that gravity has bent into more than one image.
This project uses ancient DNA and animal bones to trace when cattle, sheep and goats reached East Asia and how herding changed native habitats.
This project tracks zooplankton in a high-latitude fjord to find out which species are present in winter and early spring and how they develop.
This project builds a control system that lets people lead building tasks while robotic arms do the heavy lifting in factory-built construction.
This project studies how waves in the solar wind help heat it and speed it up, and builds a model of it using machine learning.
This project studies how two freshwater mussel species respond to changes in water temperature and sediment, using experiments, field work and an energy model.
